pages.name: home-seeded-project-grid
pages.notes: Use a fresh deviceId browser context. Inspect at least two completed seeded project cards with QA score badges and the F2 example prompt cards.

pages.name: workbench-version-timeline-and-rollback
pages.notes: Create or select a project in the same deviceId context, complete a mock follow-up, and inspect the chronological version timeline, summaries, QA badges, rollback action, and restored preview/code.

pages.name: public-read-only-share
pages.notes: Open a minted share URL in a fresh browser context without the owner's deviceId cookie. Inspect the current version preview and code and confirm the page exposes no mutation controls.

captureNotes: Run with LLM_PROVIDER=mock. Project and share captures require creating the project and share link in the same owner context before opening the share route in a clean context.
